option: A - compact truck and shared floor-mounted fittings

categories.U: unknown; null must not be interpreted as zero

measured_context.scope: one settled visual pose and flat-slab steady-state manual-yaw reference-rectangle sweep, not global minimum turn or street maneuver

truck_design.frame: design ground datum at plan center of body; +X vehicle left, +Y up, +Z forward. Not the existing runtime root.
truck_design.comment: Keep-clear boxes are design reservations, not measured swept volumes. Wheel, lamp and mirror specific no-build geometry remains U. Do not use this datum as the runtime adapter transform.

shared_floor_sockets.datum: bed floor center; y=0 is the top bed-floor mounting plane
shared_floor_sockets.support: bed floor only; never drop-side rail tops

game_asset_clearance_rule.mount_detail_rule: All module brackets and footplates remain within the declared 1.20 x 1.60 m module envelope; adjacent bed trim may use at most 0.03 m of each nominal 0.05 m gap. Reject visible/collision interpenetration.
game_asset_clearance_rule.certification: Game-asset fit rule only; not a manufacturing tolerance or real-world structural certification.

workshop_design.provenance: Room, opening, park and facility-zone reservations retained from measured-foundation fit-study, not actual existing geometry. Bench height and shelf asset dimensions newly proposed.
workshop_design.frame: room u deeper/east, v north/frontage, height up; origin at clear-room southwest. Site mapping is conditional: plan x=379.75+u, y=667.715+v.
workshop_design.swap_presentation_target: D: fixed-slot swap while safely parked, using a simple presentation cut; no physical hoist/removal path or on-foot crafting is required for this MVP proposal. Mounted/stored geometry and authoritative ownership must agree.

shutter_design.motion: stylized roll-up curtain; flexible/slatted curtain retracts into fixed overhead casing; not a rigid vertically translated full-height leaf
requirements: full actual union inside plus selected margin
shutter_design.selected_clearance_rule: D: complete actual vehicle/fitting/load union at least 0.20 m behind inner face d=+0.11, so its nearest point is d>=+0.31. The roll-up casing spans h=3.20..3.65 within 0.45 m headroom. Its 0.50 m depth is separate from the 0.22 m curtain collision allowance. Nominal 4.30 m source soffit leaves 0.65 m above casing, before actual roof/lights. No rigid 3.20 m leaf is lifted to 6.40 m.

casing.section_frame: d positive inside; d=0 curtain center plane; h above floor

retracted_curtain_volume.shape: simplified roll cylinder, axis across opening
retracted_curtain_volume.motion_representation: Stylized roll/casing display; no slat mechanics or rigid-leaf translation required

shutter_design.curtain_collision_rule: D: closed/closing free curtain occupies only the unrolled region within d=-0.11..+0.11 and opening width 4.20. When fully open, no curtain collision or sight-occluder remains below h=3.20. Static casing/retracted-roll collision stays above opening; close collision and occlusion must match visual lower edge. Runtime state/obstruction behavior is not implemented.
